name: Setuid and Setgid
description: Detects suspicious change of file privileges with chown and chmod commands, a common Linux privilege-escalation persistence mechanism. Adapted from SigmaHQ. Source: detections/rules/proc_creation_lnx_setgid_setuid.yml, hand-converted from Sigma.
query: any where process.title like~ "*chown root*" and process.title like~ ("* chmod u+s*", "* chmod g+s*")
author: Sentinel
